title: Settings
intro: Your account, your language, and your record — everything here is yours to adjust.

saved.password: Password changed. Every other session has been signed out.
saved.email: Check the new address for a confirmation link — nothing changes until it's confirmed.
saved.deletion: Your request is in. Valentina will be in touch within 7 days.

errors.pw-rate: Too many attempts — give it fifteen minutes and try again.
errors.pw-short: The new password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.email-rate: Too many requests — try again in an hour.
errors.email-format: That doesn't look like an email address.
errors.del-rate: Too many requests — try again in an hour.

profile.heading: Profile
profile.hint: Your preferred name, phone, and the birth details behind your chart.

email.label: Email
email.note: Nothing changes until you confirm from the new address — a link (valid 24 hours) goes there, and a notice goes to your current address.

password.label: Password
password.hint: At least 8 characters. Changing it signs you out on every other device.

signout.label: Sign out everywhere
signout.hint: Ends every session on every device, including this one — sign in again after.

language.heading: Language & appearance
language.label: Language
language.hint: Your whole space re-renders in the language you choose.
language.themeHint: Daylight or Dusk — remembered on this device.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.hint: These two are real switches — turn one off and that email genuinely stops.
notifications.paymentHint: A gentle note when a payment is waiting.
notifications.renewalHint: A message when your package completes, with ways to continue.
notifications.pushHint: A gentle tap on this device when something is waiting — never message content.
notifications.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
notifications.pushBlocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings for this site.
notifications.pushIosHint: On iPhone, add the app to your Home Screen first (Share → Add to Home Screen).

record.heading: Your record
record.consentHint: The exact words, the version, and the day you agreed.
record.exportHint: Everything you've created or shared here — a complete JSON copy, plus a printable keepsake of your own words.
record.deletionHint: Ask for your information to be deleted. It opens a conversation with Valentina, not an instant erase — a decision like this deserves a human check-in first.
record.deletionTimeline: Valentina reviews every request within 7 days; deletion completes within 30 days of confirmation.
record.deletionPending: Requested on {date} — Valentina will be in touch.

consentPage.title: The consent you agreed to
consentPage.agreed: You agreed to version {version} on {date}. These are the exact words, kept here for you.
consentPage.notAgreed: You haven't agreed to the current version yet — it will be offered next time it's needed.

keepsake.title: A keepsake for {name}
keepsake.intro: The reflections and answers you've written along the way, gathered in order. Print it, or save it as a PDF — it's yours.
keepsake.empty: Nothing here yet — your reflections will gather as you write them.
